_comment: The mutation gate. Scope, threshold and runner are asserted by mutation.config.test.ts; docs/testing.md explains what a surviving mutant means and how to read the report.
_thresholds_comment: break is a RATCHET: raise it as survivors are killed, never lower it. 82 -> 95 on 2026-08-03 (T044/T045) when the domain reached 100.00% over three runs, 0 survived, 0 uncovered. NOT set to 100 deliberately: 4-5 of the 151 mutants are killed by TIMEOUT, and a timeout is a wall-clock judgement. A machine faster than the one measured here could let one of them complete instead, at which point it may survive and a 100 threshold would fail a build that has no defect in it. 95 tolerates one such flip and still fails loudly on a real regression.
